metaDescription: Lamoremi Labs creates playful, easy-to-pick-up games for quick breaks, friendly competition, and one more round.
hero-description: Lamoremi Labs makes playful, easy-to-pick-up games built for quick breaks, friendly competition, and that ‘one more round’ feeling.
games-intro: We’re building a growing collection of quick, colorful games for everyone to enjoy.

games.name: Center It
games.description: Find your focus, trust your timing, and see how close to the center you can get.

games.name: Potion Sort
games.description: Sort bright, bubbling colors into their matching bottles, one satisfying move at a time.

games.name: Drop Zone
games.description: Guide your drop through changing winds and nail the moment to open your parachute.

about-description: Lamoremi Labs is an independent studio creating approachable games with a bit of personality. Our goal is to make simple, memorable experiences that are easy to jump into and fun to return to.
